header.title: Test Manager
header.description: Upload questions, control test sessions, and download color-coded result sheets.

fields.title: Title
fields.defaultMarksHint: Used when a question does not state its own marks.

upload.formatHint: Sheet columns: Question Text | Option A | Option B | Option C | Option D | Option E | Option F | Correct Answer | Marks | Question Image URL. Only the question, two options and the correct answer are required — a blank Marks cell falls back to the test's default marks. Uploading REPLACES every question in this test.
upload.emptySheet: No question rows found in that sheet.
upload.parseError: That file could not be read as an Excel/CSV sheet.

questionsEmpty.title: No questions yet
questionsEmpty.description: Add questions one at a time, or upload an Excel/CSV sheet.

scheduleModal.title: Schedule
scheduleModal.info: This tentative date & time is shown on every user's dashboard. The test only becomes takeable when you press Start — the schedule is informational.

confirm.delete: Delete this test and all its questions?
confirm.start: Start this test now? Eligible users will immediately be able to take it.
confirm.end: End this test now? Users will no longer be able to take it.

editor.questionImageHint: Optional — shown above the options (a chart, photo or diagram).
editor.optionsHint: Fill at least two. Leave the rest blank to hide them. An option may be an image, a text answer, or both. Select the radio button of the correct answer.
editor.marksHint: Leave blank to use this test's default of {{n}}.
editor.needTwoOptions: A question needs text and at least two options.
editor.lockedNote: Learners have already submitted this test. You can reword questions and options, but an option someone already chose cannot be removed.
editor.attemptsWarning: This test has submitted attempts. Questions can be edited in place, but they can no longer be deleted or bulk-replaced — that would destroy the existing result history.

danger.deleteHint: Deleting removes the test and every question in it. This cannot be undone.

exportEmpty: There are no questions to export yet.

shuffle.heading: Randomise
shuffle.hint: Presentation only — marking is unaffected. Each candidate gets a stable order for their attempt.

bulk.hint: Tick questions to delete, reorder, or set marks and topic in one go.
bulk.confirmDelete: Delete {{count}} question(s)? This cannot be undone.
bulk.failed: That bulk action could not be applied.

uploadMode.title: This test already has questions
uploadMode.body: Your sheet holds {{incoming}} question(s). This test currently has {{existing}}.
uploadMode.appendBody: Keeps what is there and appends the new rows — {{total}} in total.
uploadMode.replaceBody: Deletes the {{existing}} question(s) already in this test first.

duplicates.title: Duplicate questions
duplicates.failed: The duplicate scan could not run.
duplicates.withinHint: Usually an upload mistake — it also quietly doubles that topic's weight in the score.
duplicates.acrossHint: May be deliberate (measuring change between formative and screening) or may leak the screening paper into practice.
